titulo_es: Do you understand when you read it?

要求.consejo: It may be a request from someone or a condition that must be fulfilled.

应该.consejo: It expresses what should be done or what is expected.

注意.consejo: It is used to ask for attention or care.

认得.en: to recognize; to know from sight
认得.consejo: It is used when a person or character is recognized.

懂得.consejo: It may refer to understanding an idea or knowing how to do something.

一定.consejo: It may express security or a firm obligation, depending on the context.

马上.consejo: It indicates that something is happening very soon.

终于.consejo: It marks that something happens after waiting or trying.

影响.consejo: It may be verb or name: «have influence».

认为.consejo: Introduce an opinion that someone considers true.

其实.consejo: Add a clarification or correct an impression.

方便.consejo: Describe something practical or easy to do.

试.consejo: It's used to try an action and see what happens.

得到.consejo: He presents that you get or get something.

texto: To say that you can or cannot achieve a result, use **verbo + 得/不 + resultado o cualidad**: **看得懂** = to be able to understand when reading; **看不懂** = not to be able to understand when reading.
The order is similar to the complement in a way you saw before, but here **得/不** expresses possibility or capacity, not how the action is done.

filas: power / not being able to understand when reading
power / not being able to find

texto: **应该** expresses what is appropriate or expected to be done; **要求** is a more direct indication or request. **注意** means pay attention.
**愿意** expresses willingness or will. It is not like **应该**: one thing is to want to do something and another to consider that it is appropriate to do it.

frases.zh: 你 看 得 懂 课文 吗?
frases.en: Can you understand the text when you read it?

frases.zh: 我 看 不 懂, 有 一些 词 不 简单.
frases.es: No lo entiendo; algunas palabras no son sencillas.
frases.en: I don't understand; some words are not simple.

frases.zh: 老师 要求 我们 认真 复习.
frases.es: El profesor nos pide que repasemos con atención.
frases.en: The teacher asks us to go over it carefully.
analisis: 老师 要求 我们

frases.zh: 我 应该 查 字典, 也 愿意 再 试.
frases.es: Debería consultar el diccionario y también estoy dispuesto a intentarlo otra vez.
frases.en: I should check the dictionary and I'm also willing to try it again.

frases.zh: 注意, 这个 题 说 得 很 清楚.
frases.es: Fíjate, este ejercicio está explicado con mucha claridad.
frases.en: Look, this exercise is very clearly explained.
analisis: 说 得 很 清楚

frases.zh: 其实, 我 马上 就 懂得 了.
frases.en: Actually, I get it right away.
analisis: 马上 就 懂得 了

frases.zh: 这个 句子 看 得 懂 吗?
frases.es: ¿Se puede entender esta frase al leerla?
frases.en: Can you understand this phrase by reading it?

frases.zh: 我 看 不 懂 这 个 字.
frases.es: No puedo reconocer este carácter al leerlo.
frases.en: I can't recognize this character by reading it.
analisis: not to be able to understand

frases.zh: 你 认得 这个 人 吗?
我 认为 这个 题 很 简单.
frases.es: Creo que este ejercicio es muy sencillo.
frases.en: I think this exercise is very simple.

frases.zh: 这个 天气 影响 学习.
我 一定 马上 回答.
